entries.title: 石墨明暗素描 · 潮霧山脊
entries.titleEn: Graphite value study · Tidal mist ridge
entries.prompt: 請以「石墨明暗素描」創作原創插畫。畫面：海風吹散三層山脊間的薄霧，近處為層狀淺岩。技法：硬鉛筆畫結構，軟鉛筆疊出中灰，保留紙面亮部；用柔擦拉開高光旁的灰階，不抹平輪廓。構圖：用水平橫層分開遠近，不讓三層山脊重合。明暗：破曉薄霧光。色盤：炭黑、銀灰、紙白。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original graphite value study illustration of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground. Process: Build structure in hard graphite, layer soft graphite down to velvety middle values, and reserve white paper for highlights; lift graphite with an eraser beside bright contours rather than smudging the entire outline. Composition: Separate the ridges into overlapping horizontal depths with no competing silhouette tangencies. Value design: pale dawn haze. Palette: charcoal black, silver gray, paper white. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：觀察練習與體積研究。此配方重點：潮霧山脊。

entries.prompt: 請以「炭筆塊面」創作原創插畫。畫面：花瓣接縫上一滴水，後方僅有第二片花瓣影子。技法：以炭條側面鋪大灰塊，將形體歸納為少數明暗塊；用壓縮炭筆加深接觸陰影，讓其他邊緣斷續。構圖：微小亮點落在焦面，畫面其餘保持簡潔。明暗：透光斜逆射。色盤：炭黑、銀灰、紙白。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original charcoal mass drawing illustration of a single water drop at a petal seam with the shadow of a second petal behind it. Process: Block in large gray shapes with the side of vine charcoal and simplify form to a few value masses; reinforce contact shadows with compressed charcoal and let less important edges break away. Composition: Place the tiny highlight on the focal plane and keep the rest simple. Value design: transmitted oblique backlight. Palette: charcoal black, silver gray, paper white. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：戲劇光與剪影草圖。此配方重點：花瓣水珠。

parameters.構圖: 微小亮點落在焦面，畫面其餘保持簡潔

Composition: Separate the ridges into overlapping horizontal depths with no competing silhouette tangencies. Value design: pale dawn haze. Palette: charcoal black, silver gray, paper white. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

Composition: Crop through the bowl arc at the side and keep herbs as tiny bright accents. Value design: back-side illumination through the vapor. Palette: charcoal black, silver gray, paper white. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 請以「紅堊紙上速寫」創作原創插畫。畫面：三條斜折面接到垂直立面，窄投影切入中段。技法：在暖灰紙上用紅堊描出中間調與壓實紅褐陰影；用白堊點出紙面以上的亮部，留筆痕。構圖：讓投影擦過斜面而不切斷形體輪廓。明暗：高反差幾何投影。色盤：深紅褐、紅堊、暖灰底。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original red-chalk sheet study illustration of three tilted planes meeting a vertical wall with a narrow cast shadow through the middle. Process: Use red chalk on warm gray paper for midtones and compressed russet shadows; raise only the highest lights with white chalk and retain grain. Composition: Let the shadow graze the angled planes without losing the underlying silhouette. Value design: high-contrast light making a geometric projection. Palette: deep red-brown, red chalk, warm gray ground. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：復古素描與表面研究。此配方重點：折面投影。

entries.prompt: 請以「乾筆水彩」創作原創插畫。畫面：橋墩下有一個推車的人，濕地只反出窄亮帶。技法：用含水量低的顏料掃過粗紙，留下細碎露白與礦物顏料顆粒；在焦點補一片透明洗色，不把紙紋塗死。構圖：以粗橋墩夾出窄畫框，人物沿下緣穿過。明暗：高反差斜側光。色盤：深靛、鉛灰、冷白。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original drybrush watercolor illustration of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground. Process: Drag nearly dry pigment across rough paper, exposing tiny specks of white and mineral granulation; place one transparent glaze at the focus without filling the paper tooth. Composition: Frame a narrow opening with the piers and route the figure along its lower edge. Value design: hard upper sidelight. Palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：石材、樹皮與細節質地。此配方重點：橋腹的人影。

parameters.構圖: 以粗橋墩夾出窄畫框，人物沿下緣穿過

entries.prompt: 請以「乾筆水彩」創作原創插畫。畫面：雨後無人的路口，兩盞路燈在地上留下斷裂線條。技法：用含水量低的顏料掃過粗紙，留下細碎露白與礦物顏料顆粒；在焦點補一片透明洗色，不把紙紋塗死。構圖：讓車道線與反射收進遠端，保留一側暗值。明暗：兩類色溫燈源。色盤：深夜藍、電光青、鎢絲金。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original drybrush watercolor illustration of an empty crossroads after rain with two street lights drawing interrupted reflections. Process: Drag nearly dry pigment across rough paper, exposing tiny specks of white and mineral granulation; place one transparent glaze at the focus without filling the paper tooth. Composition: Draw lane marks and reflections into the far end and leave one side dark. Value design: two practical sources with distinct color temperatures. Palette: midnight blue, electric teal, tungsten gold. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：石材、樹皮與細節質地。此配方重點：雨後路口。

entries.promptEn: Create an original opaque gouache blocks illustration of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground. Composition: Separate the ridges into overlapping horizontal depths with no competing silhouette tangencies. Value design: pale dawn haze. Palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 請以「不透明塊面水粉」創作原創插畫。畫面：一件雙耳粗陶罐、少量細砂和一小片藍布。技法：霧面水粉以整片純色覆蓋，控制邊線鋒利或柔化的節奏；只用少數亮色收尾，避免數位式連續漸層。構圖：用中心三角輪廓整理空間，布只在底角露出。明暗：擦過表面的側光。色盤：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original opaque gouache blocks illustration of one two-handled earthenware vessel, scattered fine sand and a small blue cloth. Process: Lay down matte opaque gouache as uninterrupted color planes with rhythmic hard and soft edges; finish with a handful of light accents rather than continuous digital gradients. Composition: Use a centered triangular silhouette with cloth visible at the base corner only. Value design: raking light across the surface. Palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 請以「不透明塊面水粉」創作原創插畫。畫面：橫越平靜水面的舊木棧橋，底下有緩慢水紋。技法：霧面水粉以整片純色覆蓋，控制邊線鋒利或柔化的節奏；只用少數亮色收尾，避免數位式連續漸層。構圖：以木板的消失方向拉向遠端，把水面留在兩側。明暗：淡靛傍晚光。色盤：深夜藍、電光青、鎢絲金。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original opaque gouache blocks illustration of an old timber pier across still water with slow ripples underneath. Process: Lay down matte opaque gouache as uninterrupted color planes with rhythmic hard and soft edges; finish with a handful of light accents rather than continuous digital gradients. Composition: Lead into the distance along the decking and keep water visible on both sides. Value design: faint indigo dusk light. Palette: midnight blue, electric teal, tungsten gold. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Create an original graded ink wash illustration of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground. entries.prompt: 請以「軟粉彩層疊」創作原創插畫。畫面：一輛正穿過窄巷的單車，牆上光帶斷續。技法：用軟粉條側掃並層疊互補色，留下粉末和紙紋；焦點用碎粉點亮，周圍以疏筆銜接。構圖：橫向施動勢，讓前方有足夠空間。明暗：狹巷反射光。色盤：鐵灰、紅鏽、杏黃。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original layered soft pastel illustration of a bicycle passing across a narrow alley with broken light bands on the wall. Process: Side-sweep soft pastel and stack complementary dust layers with visible paper tooth; light the focal edge with small pastel crumbs and bridge it with sparse surrounding marks. Composition: Give the motion a lateral axis with enough lead room ahead. Value design: reflected light within the narrow alley. Palette: iron gray, vermilion rust, apricot. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：柔霧、霧面與色粉粒感。此配方重點：穿巷單車。

parameters.構圖: 橫向施動勢，讓前方有足夠空間

entries.promptEn: Create an original encaustic wax painting illustration of a single water drop at a petal seam with the shadow of a second petal behind it. Composition: Place the tiny highlight on the focal plane and keep the rest simple. Value design: transmitted oblique backlight. Palette: plum, muted rouge, pink shell. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 請以「分色點描」創作原創插畫。畫面：橫越平靜水面的舊木棧橋，底下有緩慢水紋。技法：以分離的小色點並置互補色，遠看產生視覺混色；在焦點收小色點，在背景放大點距。構圖：以木板的消失方向拉向遠端，把水面留在兩側。明暗：淡靛傍晚光。色盤：深夜藍、電光青、鎢絲金。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original divided-color pointillism illustration of an old timber pier across still water with slow ripples underneath. Process: Juxtapose complementary pigments as distinctly separate small dabs for optical mixing; tighten dot size at focus and increase spacing in the background. Composition: Lead into the distance along the decking and keep water visible on both sides. Value design: faint indigo dusk light. Palette: midnight blue, electric teal, tungsten gold. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：躍動色光與可見色點。此配方重點：水面棧橋。

entries.promptEn: Create an original reduction linocut illustration of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground. Composition: Frame a narrow opening with the piers and route the figure along its lower edge. Value design: hard upper sidelight. Palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 請以「蝕刻凹版」創作原創插畫。畫面：成人的手將一杯飲品放在近窗桌上，杯墊略偏。技法：酸蝕般的細槽裝墨，壓成沉入紙內的纖細線條；加少許版面薄墨，保留清楚的壓痕邊。構圖：讓手與杯身分別落在兩個交點，描出短運動方向。明暗：柔和環境光與局部反光。色盤：炭黑、銀灰、紙白。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original intaglio etching illustration of an adult hand setting a drink down on a table near the window with a slightly offset coaster. Process: Press ink from acid-bitten fine grooves into damp paper for recessed wiry lines; include a little wiped plate tone and a visible plate impression. Composition: Place hand and cup on neighboring grid intersections to describe a short motion. Value design: soft ambient light and a local reflection. Palette: charcoal black, silver gray, paper white. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Create an original flat screen print illustration of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground. Process: Push a small set of saturated inks through stencil mesh into flat color islands; keep broad color shapes pure and show mixing only at overlaps. Composition: Separate the ridges into overlapping horizontal depths with no competing silhouette tangencies. Value design: pale dawn haze. Palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Create an original flat screen print illustration of two switchback stairs, white railings and a narrow roof light. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Create an original two-ink duplicator print illustration of a wooden bench on light stone flooring beside a narrow door left ajar. Process: Overprint two soy-ink-like colors with visible halftones and loose paper fibers; allow small registration shifts so the layer order remains clear. Composition: Place the bench and door near opposing frame edges and leave the center open. Value design: a narrow strip of daylight through the doorway. Palette: charcoal, oat, ivory. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Create an original wiped monotype illustration of an adult waiting in an unmarked raincoat, with a readable face inside the hood. Process: Lift one impression from an inked plate and create light by wiping rather than drawing lines; retain ghost impressions and floating thin-to-thick transitions. Composition: Use the canopy as a natural frame and let the subject look away from the viewer. Value design: outdoor reflected light under cloud cover. Palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：抽象、單件印畫。此配方重點：雨衣等待者。

parameters.構圖: 用遮棚作自然框，人物不直視觀者

entries.prompt: 請以「剪紙透空」創作原創插畫。畫面：一片反覆摺疊的亞麻，縫線跨過三個折面。技法：把紙面剪成相互承托的廓形，透空形成負形；窄橋接點保持紙材連續，邊緣乾脆。構圖：以短邊俯看，讓摺痕穿越視線而非堆在中央。明暗：低角度擦光。色盤：炭灰、燕麥、象牙白。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original cut-paper silhouette illustration of one repeatedly folded linen sheet with a seam across three planes. Process: Cut interlocking paper silhouettes with negative spaces acting as design forms; bridge narrow connections so the sheet remains structurally plausible; keep edges crisp. Composition: View down over the short edge and let the folds cross the reading direction instead of piling at center. Value design: raking illumination at a low angle. Palette: charcoal, oat, ivory. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 請以「繡線圖像」創作原創插畫。畫面：花瓣接縫上一滴水，後方僅有第二片花瓣影子。技法：以平針、緞面針和結粒組出圖像，線向跟隨形體；保留布縫隙及纖維高光，不畫成塑膠。構圖：微小亮點落在焦面，畫面其餘保持簡潔。明暗：透光斜逆射。色盤：梅紫、胭脂、淺粉米。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original embroidered illustration illustration of a single water drop at a petal seam with the shadow of a second petal behind it. Process: Build the image with running stitches, satin fills and knots following the form; retain the weave gaps and thread highlights rather than plastic surfaces. Composition: Place the tiny highlight on the focal plane and keep the rest simple. Value design: transmitted oblique backlight. Palette: plum, muted rouge, pink shell. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：布章、手作角色與工藝感。此配方重點：花瓣水珠。

parameters.構圖: 微小亮點落在焦面，畫面其餘保持簡潔

entries.prompt: 請以「藍曬接觸印」創作原創插畫。畫面：成人的手將一杯飲品放在近窗桌上，杯墊略偏。技法：物件與感光紙貼合，日曬後留下普魯士藍底與白影；半透明材質以淡藍邊呈現，不加入額外色相。構圖：讓手與杯身分別落在兩個交點，描出短運動方向。明暗：接觸曝光、非攝影透視。色盤：普魯士藍、濕曬淺藍、紙白。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original cyanotype contact print illustration of an adult hand setting a drink down on a table near the window with a slightly offset coaster. Process: Press objects against sensitized paper to leave white impressions in a prussian-blue exposure; register translucent material with pale blue fringes and keep other hues absent. Composition: Place hand and cup on neighboring grid intersections to describe a short motion. Value design: contact exposure rather than camera perspective. Palette: Prussian blue, pale contact blue, paper white. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：物件痕跡、標本與剪影。此配方重點：端上一杯。

entries.promptEn: Create an original botanical whiplash ornament illustration of a wooden bench on light stone flooring beside a narrow door left ajar. Process: Interlace the subject and border with botanical whiplash curves; concentrate ornament along borders and let central shapes breathe. Composition: Place the bench and door near opposing frame edges and leave the center open. Value design: a narrow strip of daylight through the doorway. Palette: charcoal, oat, ivory. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Create an original stepped radial ornament illustration of an adult waiting in an unmarked raincoat, with a readable face inside the hood. Process: Build orderly mirror symmetry using steps, segmented fans and metallic fine lines; preserve a few high-contrast geometric incidents across large flat surfaces. Composition: Use the canopy as a natural frame and let the subject look away from the viewer. Value design: outdoor reflected light under cloud cover. Palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：門牌與戲劇化標誌構圖。此配方重點：雨衣等待者。

entries.promptEn: Create an original optical line modulation illustration of a small piece of fern with frost on the edge against a dark ground with a faint watery impression. Process: Vary repeating line density and curvature to create readable illusory depth; center the deformation on one swell and avoid competing distortions. Composition: Crop closely through a section of veins and let their ends run out of frame. Value design: uniform flat illumination. Palette: shadow green, moss gray, lime accent. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：圖形動感與抽象節奏。此配方重點：窗霜蕨葉。

entries.prompt: 請以「方塊體素世界」創作原創插畫。畫面：一小段蕨葉，葉緣沾霜，暗底有輕微浮水印狀輪廓。技法：把形體雕為可數方塊，以清楚階梯輪廓表示量體；讓地面投影與體素方向一致，避免平滑圓角。構圖：以近距離裁切截住一段葉脈，讓邊緣外延不入框。明暗：透葉逆光。色盤：墨綠、苔灰、青檸點色。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original voxel-built world illustration of a small piece of fern with frost on the edge against a dark ground with a faint watery impression. Process: Sculpt objects from countable cubes and show mass in clear stair-stepped silhouettes; align shadows with the voxel axes and avoid smoothed bevels. Composition: Crop closely through a section of veins and let their ends run out of frame. Value design: backlight passing through the leaf. Palette: shadow green, moss gray, lime accent. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：積木式場景與角色造型。此配方重點：窗霜蕨葉。

parameters.構圖: 以近距離裁切截住一段葉脈，讓邊緣外延不入框

entries.prompt: 請以「線框等高雕塑」創作原創插畫。畫面：一件雙耳粗陶罐、少量細砂和一小片藍布。技法：以連續三維等高線定義體積，局部網格沿曲率縮密；在交叉處明確給前後線條不同亮度。構圖：用中心三角輪廓整理空間，布只在底角露出。明暗：擦過表面的側光。色盤：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original wire contour sculpture illustration of one two-handled earthenware vessel, scattered fine sand and a small blue cloth. Process: Define volume with spatial contour loops and tighten local mesh along curvature; separate near and far lines by brightness where the structure crosses. Composition: Use a centered triangular silhouette with cloth visible at the base corner only. Value design: raking light across the surface. Palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.title: 線框等高雕塑 · 折面投影
entries.titleEn: Wire contour sculpture · Shadows across folds
entries.prompt: 請以「線框等高雕塑」創作原創插畫。畫面：三條斜折面接到垂直立面，窄投影切入中段。技法：以連續三維等高線定義體積，局部網格沿曲率縮密；在交叉處明確給前後線條不同亮度。構圖：讓投影擦過斜面而不切斷形體輪廓。明暗：高反差幾何投影。色盤：暗藍、赭橙、明淺砂。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original wire contour sculpture illustration of three tilted planes meeting a vertical wall with a narrow cast shadow through the middle. Process: Define volume with spatial contour loops and tighten local mesh along curvature; separate near and far lines by brightness where the structure crosses. Composition: Let the shadow graze the angled planes without losing the underlying silhouette. Value design: high-contrast light making a geometric projection. Palette: navy, ochre-orange, pale sand. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 請以「線框等高雕塑」創作原創插畫。畫面：成人手持一枝帶小葉子的莖，葉枝在中段展開。技法：以連續三維等高線定義體積，局部網格沿曲率縮密；在交叉處明確給前後線條不同亮度。構圖：讓枝葉走向大片留白，手只作尺度參照。明暗：一側柔和反射光。色盤：墨綠、苔灰、青檸點色。不加入標誌、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Create an original wire contour sculpture illustration of an adult hand holding a single small-leaved stem opening out at the middle. Process: Define volume with spatial contour loops and tighten local mesh along curvature; separate near and far lines by brightness where the structure crosses. Composition: Extend the stem into negative space and use the hand as a scale reference. Value design: soft reflected light from one side. Palette: shadow green, moss gray, lime accent. No logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
